items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: this young fellow whose name is Alan Hobbs, he's the little fellow who followed us all around

ctx.x: But it was a marvelous experience, and I got to know Lew Grade and Leslie, and Delfonte, who's a big man. In fact I think Delfonte was kind of responsible for my going over the first time, through an agent, Mumford, I think this guy's name was, Mumford. I think that's his name. I hope I remember the name correctly.

But anyway, Delfonte is a brother to the Grades. You know, they're all brothers, and they're all in different capacities, you know. But it was a marvelous, wonderful, wonderful experience, and as I say, today I hear from people, I still hear from them, and this young fellow whose name is Alan Hobbs, he's the little fellow who followed us all around, well he's now in California. He's been here for quite some time. He lives in San Francisco. So he keeps in touch and he goes back home. I guess his parents are still…
